scope: Claude HTTP service and automatic idle-stop / external-request wake using the documented compatible-endpoint option.

model_connection.endpoint: external test-only protocol adapter, separate from the Claude box

results.cold_task_only_wake_trigger: documented HTTPS POST /tasks, no preceding start/exec/cp
results.additional_control: After the second automatic stop, external GET /health restored the service; a valid boot UUID differed from the warm UUID.

credential_boundary.scan_scope: Relevant readable configuration, workspace files, logs, session files, and process environments, using agent-user and guest-root contexts. Listed unreadable entries and skipped files are not claimed to be audited. Not an exhaustive memory/disk forensic proof.

limitations: Official Anthropic endpoint was not exercised; this run used the documented compatible Messages endpoint configuration.

Unauthenticated request to the test-only model adapter returned HTTP 500, so that probe is not treated as a successful authentication assertion. The documented task service itself returned the expected 401.
This is a single-task example, not a multi-tenant load or durability test.

documentation_checks.browser: Full service source expands; desktop and 390px mobile have no page-wide horizontal overflow.
